pin.title: Wallet PIN
pin.createDescription: Your 6-digit PIN is required every time you pay with your wallet or withdraw funds. One PIN covers all your wallets.

pin.spendBlockedUntil: Payments and withdrawals are on hold until {time}.
pin.lockedUntil: Your PIN is locked until {time} after too many wrong attempts. Use Forgot PIN to set a new one.

otp.sentTo: Code sent to {email}. It is valid for 5 minutes.

errors.WALLET_PIN_SAME_AS_OLD: Your new PIN must be different from the current one.
